items.description:
Grainvest Industrial is a newer addition to the privately owned Grainvest Group, an investment company active in the agricultural and energy industries. The company procures raw materials used mainly in edible oil and food manufacturing, and as an import-export business it also deals in chemicals and polymers for various industries. The group says its grain-trading roots and more than 19 years of agricultural experience give it applied knowledge to deliver tailor-made, high-quality products.

Grainvest Industrial describes itself as a procurement specialist rather than a conventional chemical distributor, offering client-specific solutions backed by global supply relationships. The website lists its product areas as industrial water treatment, food and feed additives, agrochemicals and fertilizers, household and personal care, chlor-alkali, edible oil crushing and refining, and polymers. The company says its aim is to keep clients on track with comprehensive solutions for their processes.

GXT Fire & Security Protection provides fire protection, access control and CCTV solutions for commercial and industrial premises. Its fire protection service covers compliant systems that are designed, installed and maintained, with the stated aim of protecting assets and life safety.

Access control offerings include card readers, biometric solutions and emergency door release mechanisms, and the company says it tailors each system to the premises. For surveillance it installs IP and network cameras for high-resolution clarity, as well as analogue and turbo cameras that offer versatility.

The company says its work conforms to all applicable legislative requirements and that it aims to be on time and on budget. The website also lists 24-hour emergency support. GXT presents itself as a provider of security solutions with a focus on experience, innovation and a tailored approach for each client.

hearX is a digital hearing health technology company whose group website describes smart, evidence-based screening and testing equipment. In clinical settings its tools support hearing screening programmes and clinically validated hearing tests, which the company says help enhance patient care. For occupational health, its hearing conservation solutions are presented as a way for employers to meet regulatory compliance.

For retail environments, the company offers in-store and online hearing testing. The company says its digital audiometry solutions do not need a soundproof booth, which it notes saves time, set-up fees and other costs, because assessments can be carried out on site. The website also lists a hearX blog, published research and a resource section called Xplore, and it describes its hearing technologies as trusted globally and award-winning.

Hill View Consulting is one of the divisions of a group that describes itself as Centurion-based and also includes Hill View Invest and a Pro-Active Maintenance service. Hill View Consulting focuses mainly on project management, engineering and construction, and it offers coaching and mentoring.

Its vision is to be a preferred consulting resource on demand, and its mission is to increase the probability that projects succeed on budget, to acceptable quality and on time, while considering safety, health and environment and managing risk. It presents itself as an objective third party focused on delivery and continuous improvement. The group's Pro-Active Maintenance division offers inspection and thermography for body corporates, sectional title trustees and small businesses, supplying summary reports with repair quotations and forward-looking maintenance budgets so that the client makes the decision. Hill View Invest focuses on stock market brokering, retirement products and tax planning.

Holistic Labour Group is a labour consultancy made up of several divisions, each managed by experienced specialists who have served clients across South Africa for many years. The group offers expert legal advice and representation at the CCMA, bargaining councils, the Department of Labour, union meetings and negotiations, and the Labour Court.

Its services include sound labour relations, which aims to promote fairness, communication and collaboration between employers and employees, and labour law solutions. Through Holistic Flexible Staffing Solutions it supplies professional, skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled workers on request.

The company says it can service all labour industries in South Africa, and its clients range from large corporates to individual households that employ domestic workers. The website also lists a newsroom and a CTL Management Forum. The group offers customised solutions for workforce management, compliance and operational efficiency.

Hussar Security and Defense Solutions was established as a closed corporation in 2008 to develop armoured personnel carrier services for clients with high-risk profiles. In 2014 it expanded into unmanned aircraft services, and after unmanned systems legislation was introduced in 2015 it became involved in consultation between government and industry on the subject.

Its listed specialised services include surveillance, unmanned aircraft, innovative security strategies, armoured personnel carriers and specialised vehicles configured as mobile control rooms for unmanned system operations. The company also lists electronic human detection systems, non-lethal intervention systems for crowd and intruder control, and counter-drone services. Its website says it now offers counter-drone surveillance and investigations to protect airspace, privacy and critical infrastructure from rogue drone activity. The website states that the safety of people and the well-being of the environment come first in its work.

IdealiConnect provides smart infrastructure for venues, combining guest WiFi, IoT access and CCTV so that venue owners can focus on their customers. Its smart guest WiFi offering uses POPIA-compliant captive portals with custom branded splash pages, automated data capture, bandwidth management and real-time guest analytics.

The company says it syncs visitor data from each WiFi session to HubSpot or Mailchimp, which supports automated email campaigns, visitor segmentation and revenue attribution. Its security range includes HD IP camera systems, ANPR gate access, remote monitoring and cloud video storage, along with dashcam telematics integrated into a client's network.

For contactless engagement it offers NFC and QR-powered access for staff, VIPs and automated check-ins, including tap-to-connect NFC cards. The website also lists satellite and rural connectivity. The company describes its role as designing, installing and managing the complete connected venue.

Ikhaya Futurehouse Systems (IFHS) makes thermally insulating wall and slab building panels. The company says its walling system is easy to use, low-maintenance, has the look of concrete and is cost competitive with brick and mortar. It states that the IFHS building system is compliant with the new SANS 204 and 10400-XA legislation, and that its materials are sourced and manufactured in South Africa.

The range extends beyond walling to under-floor insulation, suspended floor and roof slabs, insulated ceilings, plastering and finishing systems, and double-glazed window and door systems. Services include on-site training, engineering and construction consultancy.

The website positions the products as eco-friendly, saying they save building time and energy and make buildings more comfortable to live in. The site also includes a building system video and a projects section.

Incredible Direction supplies industrial components to the mining and industrial sectors. Its product range includes pumps, valves, pipes and tubes, fittings, bearings and couplings, seals and packings, electric motors, instruments, industrial fans and electrical supplies. It also offers pump and valve repair, covering repair, refurbishment and testing.

The company describes its aim as keeping mines moving and keeping industry strong, and says it drives industrial performance responsibly. Its website highlights high-performance pumps for critical applications, industrial valves, reliable fittings, and industrial fans for power plants and mines.

In its corporate social responsibility section, the company says it is dedicated to giving back to the community and supports the development of disadvantaged and vulnerable communities. It reports a BEE Level One status.

Inelda Freight is a clearing and forwarding agent that handles import and export shipments. The company manages customs clearance, documentation and end-to-end freight coordination, and says it works closely with carriers, ports and authorities to reduce delays and keep compliance on track.

Its listed services are customs clearing, freight forwarding by air, sea and road, and cargo tracking and delivery coordination, including proactive shipment updates and last-mile delivery coordination. It also offers ITAC permit services. The website states that the company was established in 1987 and focuses on accurate paperwork, clear communication and dependable follow-through. Its stated mission is to simplify cross-border logistics through accuracy, accountability and timely delivery coordination, backed by clear shipment visibility.

InQuesTech designs, builds and runs enterprise digital platforms for government departments and regulated industries. The company says it works on mission-critical systems used by government departments, insurers, banks and telecom operators. Its flagship platform, InQuest Invoice, brings invoicing, estimates and payments into one place.

Its services include enterprise platform engineering using Java and Spring Boot, digital public platforms with secure portals and workflows that have audit trails built in, mobile field solutions for inspectors and frontline teams, and data systems built on PostgreSQL with mapping where needed. The company says security, privacy and traceability are built in by default for regulated industries, and it offers embedded teams from architecture through to production support. InQuesTech states that it has more than 15 years of experience and has delivered more than 50 projects.

Inscorp Insurance Brokers (Pty) Ltd has been operating since 2012 and says every business is unique, so it looks at each client's needs individually. Its business insurance covers costs of property damage, lawsuits and loss of business income, including all-risk asset cover.

Liability cover protects companies and business owners against formal lawsuits and third-party claims. Transport and logistics cover extends to heavy haulage fleets, buses, light delivery fleets and motor fleets on conventional and non-conventional bases, including various types of cargo cover. The firm partners with specialist aviation insurers for aviation cover.

For individuals it specialises in executive home and car insurance. Clients can submit quote requests online, and the website includes FAIS information for the firm's clients.

Instacom is a technology partner that provides IoT solutions and workforce communication and monitoring systems to organisations. The company says its suite lets clients communicate, monitor, equip and energise their workforce, with accountability and real-time reporting at every point of contact. Its hardware is ICASA and IP certified, and it describes its systems as POPI compliant.

Instacom presents its offering as capture, process and report solutions with tailored software, and says its communication network is prioritised and built for redundancy. The website lists sectors it has served, including security, facility management, military, logistics, cleaning, health care, mining, construction, and public sectors such as police, ambulance services, traffic and waste management. The company says it has operated for 14 years and runs a 24/7 customer care centre.

Interactive Oasis is a small team of developers that builds web and mobile applications, and says it has more than 15 years of experience doing so. The company has delivered solutions in medical and healthcare systems, trade analytics dashboards and engineering-based applications, and it also works with startups and small businesses.

Recent work listed on its website includes the WedReady web application and iOS and Android app, the SolutionCorp web application and platform, the Parkupp website, a Beachside Skydive web platform and the Stratalyze platform. Its process has three stages: discovery and design, where it delivers a Figma prototype before development begins; agile development in short sprints with progress shared at each milestone; and launch and support, which includes full source-code handover once requirements are met, plus ongoing support.

Jemstech is an electronic manufacturing services (EMS) company that describes itself as a leading EMS provider in Southern Africa. It works as a compliant contract manufacturer, supporting both high-volume production runs and low-volume specialised builds, from prototype to production. The company says its industry focus includes aerospace and defence, industrial electronics, telecommunications and automotive.

Its website lists manufacturing since 2024 from a production facility of 1000 square metres, with a team of ten or more employees. The company emphasises precision, reliability and scalability at every stage of production. In May 2025 it reported that its rooftop solar installation was fully operational.

JM Venter Property Services CC was established in 2002 and provides property management services. It administers sectional title bodies corporate and homeowners associations, and it also manages gated and commercial communities with a tailored, all-inclusive solution.

Its services include secretarial services, pro-active credit control, strict financial control, preventative maintenance programmes and invoicing. The company says it plans, organises, leads and controls the administration duties of the bodies it serves. It states that it is supported by specialist technology systems and infrastructure to meet property owners' needs.

Its vision is to provide property management services and advice at managerial, secretarial and accounting levels. The company says it keeps abreast of the latest developments and practices in its field of expertise.

Just Stone Projects has been a stone specialist since 1993, providing premium fabrication and installation of granite, marble, quartz and sintered surfaces, including sintered porcelain. The company says its service runs from first consultation to final sign-off, with custom designs to suit each space and budget.

Its process includes accurate measurement and templating, so that tops fit without rework. It states that it offers on-time installation with minimal disruption and clear communication at every stage. The company is a registered KSA kitchen member and supplier, and its website says it has more than 30 years of industry experience.

Its customers include homeowners, designers and builders. The business says its focus is reliability, trust, precision and execution rather than price.

Kalinda Trading is a peanut and peanut butter manufacturer that describes itself as one of South Africa's renowned peanut manufacturers. The company says its peanuts are locally produced with trusted suppliers, hand-picked, and processed using heritage techniques combined with modern equipment.

Its operations include roasting peanuts and pre-packaging peanut butter, and it offers research and development functions drawn from its industry knowledge. Its products are described as quality and healthy products for retail customers.

The company's mission is to process peanut-related products for businesses and entrepreneurs across Africa. The website also describes a farming upliftment project that aims to empower farmers and communities to become financially independent. Kalinda says its purpose is to build the peanut industry and relationships that last.

Katlego Security Services (Pty) Ltd describes itself as a proudly South African small business in the security industry. The company's stated view is that the future of security lies in a balance between technology and manpower, with cutting-edge technology supported by skilled personnel.

Its listed services include guarding, technology, crowd control, road safety and investigations, as well as close protection, conflict resolution, intelligence operations, polygraphs and emergency preparedness. The company holds B-BBEE Level 2 contributor status and says it is accredited as a security service provider. It is also listed as a National Key Point service provider.

Katlego says it manages its employees, stakeholders and assets with due diligence and safeguards them according to baseline security requirements, with continued security risk management. The website also offers a company profile for download.

KIT Formwork is a proudly South African-owned company that supplies precision-engineered formwork solutions for residential, commercial and civil construction projects. The company says its formwork kits are designed for safety, efficiency and compliance with modern building standards, and that they simplify complex builds while maintaining structural integrity and performance.

The website states that the company has been in the business for over 85 years, which it says gives it a deep understanding of the challenges on every construction project, big or small. Its services cover formwork sales, technical expertise, engineering drawings and customer service, with a focus on safety. KIT says it supports clients from the earliest planning stage through to on-site assistance, and that its wide product range is backed by a team with expertise and a solutions-driven mindset.

Kleutergenot is a preschool for children aged 0 to 6 that describes its approach as having a Christian foundation and emotional support for optimal growth. The school day runs from 06:30 to 17:30, and the school closes only over the 12-day Christmas period. The website says the school offers a unique, dynamic curriculum with continuous, meaningful assessment, and it specialises in sport, music, science and language development.

The school says it aims to develop each child across spiritual, intellectual, physical, self-image, structural, social and creative areas. It employs a full-time sport teacher who trains every child, and a full-time music teacher who offers weekly music lessons.

Qualified preschool teachers are supported by relief staff for absences. Activities include rugby, art, pottery and netball, and a Grade R programme prepares children for further learning. Parents are kept informed through WhatsApp, practice guides and newsletters.

Legacy Risk Consult is an insurance services company that brings insurance, technology and consulting expertise together for South Africa's funeral parlours, group schemes, businesses, brokers and micro-insurers. Its six services are administration, consulting, brokerage, product development, underwriting and tech innovation.

Administration aims to simplify the policy lifecycle, while consulting helps clients find a clear way forward. Brokerage equips brokers and agents, product development turns market needs into products, and underwriting connects risk insight with pricing. The tech innovation service brings operations together into connected insurance operations.

The company describes its values as partnership, integrity, innovation and community, saying it works alongside clients and their insurers and offers practical tools for real challenges. Its stated focus is practical solutions and lasting working relationships.

LeSi is the restaurant at Casa Toscana, a venue that hosts functions, conferences, year-end events and weddings. The restaurant is presented as a singing restaurant that offers a theatrical musical experience with dinner, in what the website describes as a unique, intimate and romantic ambiance.

Its menus include breakfast or brunch, a lighter lunch menu and a performing restaurant dinner. Casa Toscana also runs Die Blou Hond theatre, which hosts South African entertainment shows, with a platter dinner menu. Its function spaces include the Chianti Garden Tent, Rubica Hall and The Wine Cellar.

The Casa Toscana Lodge offers 20 luxury rooms with amenities and is positioned for romantic getaways and business travellers. The website describes the accommodation as four-star.
